name: Seated Knee Tuck
steps: Sit on the floor with your palms behind your hips and lean back slightly.
Brace your abdomen and lift your straight legs clear of the floor.
Brace your abs and pull both knees smoothly inward toward your chest while bringing your torso slightly forward to meet them.
Pause briefly in the tucked position with your abs firmly contracted.
Extend your legs back out straight while leaning slightly back without letting your heels touch the floor.
tips: Keep your chest lifted and lower back controlled instead of collapsing into a deep slump.
Use your hands lightly for balance rather than bearing all your weight on your arms.
